body.name: sector norm program
body.construction: Write \(f(d,q)=z^{\top}Gz+2h^{\top}z+c_0\) for \(z=(d,q)^{\top}\), with \(G=\Delta^{-2}\begin{pmatrix}(s^2+u^2+2t^2)/4&t(s+u)\\t(s+u)&s^2+u^2+2t^2\end{pmatrix}\), \(h=\Delta^{-2}(-(s^2+t^2)/4,-t(s+u)/2)^{\top}\), and \(H_{\sigma}=\{z:C_{\sigma}z\ge a_{\sigma}\}\) using the four rows \((1,0)\), \((-1,0)\), \(\sigma_b(-t/(2\Delta),-s/\Delta)\), and \(\sigma_c(t/(2\Delta),u/\Delta)\) with thresholds \(0\), \(-1\), \(\eta\), and \(\eta+\sigma_ct/(2\Delta)\).
